data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 369.552m. The movement on prior years (the 'change in prior year provisions' note) shows a gross strengthening of approximately GBP 0.002m (a negligible amount relative to opening reserves). The year also records a large RITC take-on of reserves (gross GBP 1,251.064m) which substantially increased the reported 2018 gross claims outstanding to GBP 1,331.490m; however the explicit prior-year re-estimation itself was essentially flat/very small adverse. The modest prior-year movement is attributed to small adverse re-estimates partially offset by reinsurance recoveries and favourable run-off in a number of classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement taken from Note 17 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross = 2 GBP '000). There is a large RITC take-on of reserves (gross GBP 1,251,064k) in 2018 which materially increases 2018 gross claims outstanding but is a transfer, not a pure run-off movement. Some narrative figures in the report are presented net of reinsurance; where possible gross figures from the technical provisions and claims development tables were used. The claims development table is present but partially cropped in the scanned image; values were transcribed from visible rows. Minor negative/adjustment amounts in the premium mix (e.g. Fire, Third party) are printed in the report as negative adjustments.
